name: glitterpony_meg
tag: u are all horses to me (this is the highest compliment)
about: HI!! i'm meg!! i love horses (all of them), unicorns (real to me), and drawing my friends as horses in MS paint (free, forever, no exceptions). i have been to a real stable 4 times and each time changed me. current project: drawing everyone on ourspace as a horse. progress: 14 of everyone. if u are reading this, ur next. this is a promise and a warning!!

interests.General: horses, unicorns (real), pegasi (researching), MS paint (spray can tool), glitter gel pens, the stable (4 visits), drawing my friends as horses (free) (forever), my breyer horses (11) (they have names), horse books, being nice (aggressively)
interests.Music: kelly clarkson, the spirit soundtrack (bryan adams) (i cried), hilary duff, the cheetah girls (they're not horses but they're close), any song with 'run' in it (horse song)
interests.Movies: spirit: stallion of the cimarron (17 times), black beauty (i had to stop halfway) (i finished it) (i cried), seabiscuit (my dad's pick) (GOOD pick), the last unicorn (REAL)
interests.Television: the saddle club!! animal planet (the horse parts) (all of it), that's so raven, the kentucky derby (once a year) (i pick the one with the best mane)
interests.Books: every horse book at the library (the librarian started a shelf for me), black beauty, misty of chincoteague, the saddle club (all 100), the breyer catalog (it's a book to me)
interests.Heroes: all horses. ms. keller (my art teacher). patrick (he hung my drawing on his REAL wall). rocky (his rock) (a good horse). my mom for driving to the stable (4 times)
